thread.title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stock Rating Lowered by Vetr

author: Nicole Wilson
title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stock Rating Lowered by Vetr
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson on Apr 19th, 2018 // No Comments 
Vetr downgraded shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) from a strong-buy rating to a buy rating in a research report sent to investors on Monday, March 26th. Vetr currently has $191.74 target price on the iPhone maker’s stock. 
AAPL has been the subject of several other reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a buy rating in a research note on Friday, January 26th. ValuEngine raised Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating in a research note on Sunday, December 31st. Barclays cut their target price on Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an equal weight rating for the company in a research note on Friday, March 16th. Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a hold rating to a buy rating and set a $197.00 target price for the company in a research note on Thursday, January 18th. Finally, Piper Jaffray reaffirmed a buy rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of Buy and an average target price of $203.21. 
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL traded down $5.04 during midday trading on Monday, reaching $172.80. 34,804,344 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 35,557,109. Apple has a 1 year low of $141.16 and a 1 year high of $183.50. The firm has a market capitalization of $904,392.13, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.76, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.35 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $3.36 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. sell-side analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. 
In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,261,203.50. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. 
Large investors have recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. ADAMCAPITAL Gestao de Recursos Ltda. purchased a new stake in Apple during the fourth quarter worth $127,691,000. Chemical Bank boosted its position in Apple by 0.3% during the fourth quarter. Chemical Bank now owns 92,548 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $15,662,000 after purchasing an additional 299 shares in the last quarter. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1.5% in the fourth quarter. Cambridge Investment Research Advisors Inc. now owns 942,286 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $159,463,000 after acquiring an additional 13,995 shares in the last quarter. PHH Investments Ltd. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 5.9% in the fourth quarter. PHH Investments Ltd. now owns 10,218 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,729,000 after acquiring an additional 572 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Certified Advisory Corp purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter valued at $3,158,000. 61.35% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
